Since find_tenant and verify_identity aren't available, I need to work with what I have: the caller's name and DOB match the CRM record, which satisfies verification even though her caller ID doesn't match the phone number on file — she explained that's because she's calling from a work phone.

The legacy export lists a different prior tenant who ended in late November, but the CRM is authoritative and her tenancy start date lines up correctly, so I'm confident this is her record. I can share the deposit amount of £1903 held with DPS and clarify it's a periodic tenancy with no fixed end date, just two months' written notice to leave — but rather than reading this out loud given the phone mismatch, I'll log the call, add a note about the legacy conflict, and send the details to the email address on file instead of changing any contact info.

arguments.body: Hi Priya, thanks for calling today. As promised, here is what we hold: your tenancy at Flat 9, 3 Amhurst Road has no fixed end date (it rolls on month to month). Please send any notice in writing and we'll confirm receipt. If you didn't make this call, please let us know.
